lines:
flowchart TD
  Manifest["Workspace Instructions: automatic_context plugin"] --> Settings["Settings availability and configuration"]
  Settings --> Select["Agent node plugin checkbox, independent of Skills"]
  Select --> Freeze["Core validates and freezes selection, configuration and authority"]
  Freeze --> Enabled{"Selected for this node or child?"}
  Enabled -->|No| Skip["No automatic loader contribution"]
  Enabled -->|Yes| Boundary["Common preparation before every Agent request"]
  Boundary --> Visibility["Inspect actual visible context plus admitted loader metadata"]
  Visibility --> Reconcile["Baseline, file changes, resume or post-compaction restoration"]
  Reconcile --> Read["Bounded reads through existing core-approved filesystem access"]
  Read --> Render["Reference templates, scoped rules, dedup and shared byte budget"]
  Render --> Commit["Commit message delta to existing history before dispatch"]
  Commit --> Request["Text-only or tool-capable provider request"]
  Request --> Touch["Observe successful file operations after settled result and step"]
  Touch --> Boundary
  Replaced["Future compactor replaces visible selection; plugin contract implemented and tested now"] --> Boundary
  Contract["No callable function required; no separate memory database; .aworkit home"] -.-> Manifest

data.title: Workspace Instructions plugin activation and request preparation
